method: Public Meta Ad Library cards retained and human-coded by advertiser, FanDuel product category, message, offer pressure, state relevance and strategy. Variant counts are only used when the public card explicitly reported multiple ads using the creative and text.
boundary: This archive is not a complete census of advertising and does not reveal spend, impressions, reach, targeting or business outcomes. State relevance is coded from advertiser, copy or destination evidence; it is not proof that a state was targeted. The strategic-strength score is a descriptive proxy, not measured effectiveness. Corrected comparison scope: DraftKings, BetMGM, Bet365 and Fanatics Sportsbook. Missing cards are evidence gaps, not inactivity.
